summary: Measure energy and rank URI Process optimization opportunities

delivery.outcome: Versioned URI Process samples include bounded Linux energy and pressure observations, and a read-only query ranks recurring optimization opportunities by an explicit resource objective.
nonGoals: Create or mutate cgroups, scheduling policy or process authorization.
Claim process-exclusive energy attribution from shared package counters.
Capture command arguments, output, environment values, cgroup paths or secrets.
Automatically apply an optimization from a single sample.

architecture.decision: Keep measurement append-only and advisory: observe existing Linux counters without privilege, retain v1 reads, label attribution confidence, and rank savings independently for CPU, wall time, energy or I/O.
dataChanges: Append v2 sample records; existing v1 JSONL remains readable.
architecture.rollback: Stop emitting v2 samples and remove the opportunities query; append-only v1 and v2 records remain auditable.

validation.evidence: versioned closed schema and operation catalog
